rationale: The supplied reviewed inventory only supports bounded synthetic numeric search/evaluation and does not include any capability for molecular component handling, mixture combination, heating, ingredient addition, laboratory process planning, or chemistry-specific validation. Because the user intent explicitly asks for a synthetic research process that combines two molecular components, heats the combined mixture, then adds a third component, the correct action is to request missing capabilities rather than fabricate a graph with unsupported primitives. The requested campaign therefore focuses on capability acquisition requirements needed before any future campaign can be proposed.

gaps.purpose: Enable construction of a future campaign graph that can represent a sequential molecular process: combine two specified components, apply heating to the combined mixture, then add a third component. This is needed because the current reviewed tools only support synthetic numeric search and cannot express the requested chemistry/process sequence.

inputs.name: component_a
inputs.description: Typed identifier or structured record for the first molecular component.

inputs.name: component_b
inputs.description: Typed identifier or structured record for the second molecular component.

inputs.name: component_c
inputs.description: Typed identifier or structured record for the third molecular component added after heating.

inputs.name: process_constraints
inputs.description: Typed constraints describing allowed ordering, heating window, and mixture handling semantics.

outputs.name: process_plan
outputs.description: Structured plan that preserves the required order of combining, heating, and adding ingredients.

applicability: Any campaign that must explicitly model ordered molecular operations.
Any campaign that needs to preserve sequential material-handling dependencies.
Any campaign that should distinguish pre-heating and post-heating addition steps.
gaps.evidence_need: A reviewed tool or schema that can represent molecular entities, ordered mixture operations, and a heating step as typed executable or plan primitives.
acceptance_criteria: The capability can encode at least one explicit sequence: combine A and B, heat the combined mixture, then add C.
The capability preserves sequential dependencies without collapsing them into an unordered abstraction.
The capability exposes typed ports or equivalent bindings for the molecular inputs and process-plan output.
The capability documentation or schema demonstrates supported handling of process order and material combination semantics.

gaps.purpose: Enable evaluation of candidate molecular process plans against chemistry-specific criteria instead of synthetic numeric objectives. This is needed because the only evaluator available is explicitly synthetic numeric and the context forbids inventing scientific validation.

inputs.name: candidate_plan
inputs.description: A proposed sequential process plan for review or scoring.

inputs.name: evaluation_policy
inputs.description: Typed policy specifying what chemistry/process properties must be assessed.

outputs.name: evaluation_result
outputs.description: Assessment of whether the candidate plan meets chemistry/process validation requirements.

applicability: Campaigns that compare alternative molecular process plans.
Campaigns that require validation beyond synthetic numeric fitness.
Campaigns that need evidence-bearing evaluation of process feasibility or constraints.
gaps.evidence_need: A reviewed evaluator or simulator with chemistry-specific semantics, including ordered process checks and material-operation validation.
acceptance_criteria: The evaluator accepts a molecular-process-plan-like input.
The evaluator returns a chemistry-specific result rather than a synthetic numeric score.
The evaluator can assess ordering and step-dependency constraints.
The evaluator is explicitly listed among reviewed releases with exact bindings.
gaps.graph_gap: There is no supported evaluator in the supplied inventory for chemistry-specific or molecular-process validation.

acceptance_criteria: The primitive can encode combine-before-heat and heat-before-add constraints.
The primitive supports branching or joining after sequential material operations if needed.
The primitive has exact reviewed release metadata and bindings.
